response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - benchmark.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > benchmark.average_share
